description: Climate Adaptation Knowledge Exchange (CAKE) is a web tool or resource listed in U.S. Climate Resilience Toolkit, a national climate-adaptation toolkit, published or maintained by EcoAdapt; Island Press; CAKE Partners & Contributors. Access adaptation case studies, virtual library resources, a directory of adaptation practitioners, and a database of relevant tools on this website. Users can also participate in community forums or contribute resources. This resource was founded by the non-profit organizations EcoAdapt and Island Press in July 2010, and is managed by EcoAdapt. Coverage: the United States, or as stated on the tool page. The toolkit lists hazards: Air Quality, Changing Seasons, Drought, Erosion and Shoreline Recession, Extreme Cold, Extreme Heat, Flooding – Coastal, Flooding – General, Flooding – Rainfall-induced, High Winds, Shifting Species, Habitats, and Ecosystems, Vector-Borne Disease, Water Quality, Wildfire. Assets: Agriculture and Food Supply, Critical Facilities, Economy, Energy and Utilities, Natural Areas and Wildlife, People, Property, Transportation and Mobility, Urban Landscape and Tree Canopy, Water Infrastructure – Drinking Water, Water Infrastructure – General, Water Infrastructure – Stormwater, Water Infrastructure – Wastewater. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the toolkit page (no licence or terms statement seen). Caveats: this record was written from the toolkit page, which was read; the tool itself was not opened or run, its licence and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support climate-adaptation planning and exposure screening. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-us-climate-resilience-toolkit-catalogue.
